review_summary.executive_summary: Automated Code Review for 'OrderController.java' (Java). Overall Code Health Score: 58.0/100 (Grade F). Identified 4 finding(s): 2 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium, 2 Low. Verdict: Changes Requested.

critical.title: Java SQL Injection via Dynamic Statement Concatenation
critical.description: Direct string concatenation into an SQL statement via java.sql.Statement. Allows external actors to manipulate query structure and access or alter unauthorized database tables.
critical.potential_impact: Complete compromise of database confidentiality and authentication bypass.
critical.suggested_remediation: Replace Statement with java.sql.PreparedStatement and set parameters via setString/setInt.

low.title: Stack Trace Exposure via printStackTrace()
low.description: Calling e.printStackTrace() outputs detailed stack traces to standard error, leaking system paths, library versions, and query fragments to potential attackers.
low.potential_impact: Provides valuable diagnostic intelligence to attackers during penetration testing.
low.suggested_remediation: Use structured SLF4J / Logback logging with masked sensitive parameters.
